user.title: HouseFly
user.description: Pick what the fly can sense and, optionally, what it may touch. Actuation is off by default: until you turn it on it only watches and walks.

error.too_many_inputs: That is more sensors than the antennal lobe has glomeruli. Pick fewer.
error.too_many_outputs: Too many outputs. A fly lands on a few things, not everything.
error.unsafe_output: One or more of those cannot be fly-controlled. Locks, covers, climate, water heaters and anything named like it matters are refused.
